events.headline: Definitive Centrus fuel contracts
events.fact: Oklo signed multiyear HALEU supply agreements covering fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses; deliveries from the Ohio plant are scheduled to start in 2029.

impacts.title: Fuel procurement becomes more concrete
impacts.implication: Definitive supply arrangements reduce procurement uncertainty; the delivery schedule, fabrication and project financing remain execution gates.

impacts.title: Fuel sourcing supports the thesis
impacts.implication: A binding fuel supply agreement is stronger evidence than a letter of intent; it is not delivered fuel or an operating license.

assessment.reason: Definitive fuel supply contracts strengthen the fuel-procurement condition, not commercial readiness as a whole.

impacts.title: Fuel procurement and financing
impacts.implication: Fuel availability improves but contractual purchases may require funding. Payment amounts and their effect on project runway are not quantified; retain reported cash and burn figures.

events.headline: Expanded supplier capacity commitments
events.fact: NVIDIA announced further substrate and packaging capacity agreements, including multibillion-dollar support for SPIL and capacity expected to increase by mid-2029.

impacts.title: Supply expansion supports production capacity
impacts.implication: Long-dated supply access could ease production constraints; contracted capacity is not realized sales.

impacts.title: Supplier commitments and prepayments
impacts.implication: Capacity security trades off against future commitments and capital at risk if customer demand disappoints. The incremental payment schedule is unquantified.

assessment.reason: New multiyear supplier funding and commitments merit monitoring until timing and exposure are reconciled to filings.

impacts.title: Supplier funding and cash conversion
impacts.implication: Prepayments and supplier funding may affect future cash conversion; do not treat them as reported capex or add them to previously disclosed obligations without reconciliation.

impacts.title: Demand and capacity alignment
impacts.implication: Long-dated capacity increases the importance of matching supply with realized customer demand; it does not establish inventory impairment.

events.headline: AWS–Minfy collaboration extended to 2031
events.fact: Minfy and AWS announced a five-year worldwide collaboration covering industry-specific AI solutions, with a target three times the previous agreement.

impacts.title: Partner-led AWS demand
impacts.implication: The expanded scope supports enterprise AI adoption through partners, but commercial targets are not guaranteed AWS revenue or RPO.

impacts.title: AWS demand evidence
impacts.implication: Additional partner-channel activity is consistent with expanding demand; financial scale is not disclosed and sustained growth still requires reported evidence.

events.headline: Google Cloud publishes TPU and GPU training benchmarks
events.fact: Google Cloud released MLPerf results for Ironwood TPUs and NVIDIA Blackwell accelerators across training workloads.

impacts.title: Custom silicon capability
impacts.implication: A broader accelerator portfolio can improve customer choice and differentiation; benchmark results alone do not establish revenue growth or unit economics.

impacts.title: Customer-owned accelerator alternatives
impacts.implication: Google's own TPU development illustrates substitution risk while Blackwell availability also indicates ongoing NVIDIA ecosystem participation. No lost orders are established.

impacts.title: Competing cloud accelerator portfolio
impacts.implication: Google's TPU and GPU portfolio reinforces competition in AI infrastructure; evaluate AWS Trainium demand and workload-level economics rather than infer market-share loss.

events.headline: Accounts grew as daily trades fell year over year
events.fact: October accounts rose 34%, daily revenue trades fell 4%, and margin balances rose 31% year over year.

impacts.title: Accounts grew as daily trades fell year over year
impacts.implication: Account growth supports franchise scale. Track accompanying client equity and funding.

impacts.title: Accounts grew as daily trades fell year over year
impacts.implication: The gap between accounts and trading shows why new customer growth should be checked against activity and commissions.

impacts.title: Accounts grew as daily trades fell year over year
impacts.implication: Higher margin balances increase exposure. Compare the larger book with collateral coverage and reported losses.

events.headline: Q3 earnings and capital context
events.fact: Commissions reached $602M, net interest income reached $1.154B, and the reported pretax margin fell one point to 78%. The 10-Q also reports subsidiary regulatory capital.

impacts.title: Q3 earnings and capital context
impacts.implication: Reported earnings grew with a slightly lower pretax margin. Track whether margin pressure persists.

impacts.title: Q3 earnings and capital context
impacts.implication: Assess each regulated subsidiary against its own requirement. The consolidated earnings figure cannot establish its buffer.

events.headline: October FOMC minutes clarify rate risk
events.fact: The October vote maintained the target at 3.75%–4.00%, with two members preferring an increase.

impacts.title: October FOMC minutes clarify rate risk
impacts.implication: Client balances, asset yields and deposit costs mediate how rate changes affect brokerage earnings.

events.headline: October funding and engagement
events.fact: Funded customers rose to 28.9M and October net deposits reached $15.1B. The November presentation identified about $6.5B from Trump Accounts in October.

impacts.title: October funding and engagement
impacts.implication: Customers increased by roughly 130,000 from September. Review how customer growth translates into recurring engagement.

impacts.title: October funding and engagement
impacts.implication: Separate the program contribution before extrapolating October asset gathering.

events.headline: Q3 monetisation and earnings bridge
events.fact: Gold subscribers rose 34% to about 5.18M. Diluted EPS was $0.51 and adjusted EPS was $0.60, with reported earnings including unrealized investment losses.

impacts.title: Q3 monetisation and earnings bridge
impacts.implication: Paid membership expanded materially year over year.

impacts.title: Q3 monetisation and earnings bridge
impacts.implication: The mix of subscriptions, trading and interest revenue matters for how repeatable per-customer monetisation is.

impacts.title: Q3 monetisation and earnings bridge
impacts.implication: Review reported and adjusted earnings together and track core operating profit.

events.headline: Card portfolio aging
events.fact: Past-due card receivables reached $102M on $1.841B of receivables, including loans on and off balance sheet.

impacts.title: Card portfolio aging
impacts.implication: The portfolio is both larger and more delinquent than at year-end 2025. Losses and recoveries will determine the financial impact.

events.headline: AWS sales and operating profit grew
events.fact: AWS sales were $46.0B and operating income $17.8B, up from $30.9B and $11.4B a year earlier.

impacts.title: AWS sales and operating profit grew
impacts.implication: Demand accelerated year over year. Track growth as new capacity comes online.

impacts.title: AWS sales and operating profit grew
impacts.implication: Segment operating margin was about 38.7%, above the year-ago level.

impacts.title: AWS sales and operating profit grew
impacts.implication: Profit growth is a positive input. Compare it with incremental segment assets and depreciation before judging capital productivity.

events.headline: AI infrastructure spending absorbed cash
events.fact: Trailing operating cash flow reached $168.3B while Amazon-defined free cash flow swung from a $14.8B inflow to a $42.4B outflow.

impacts.title: AI infrastructure spending absorbed cash
impacts.implication: Cash from operations grew, but the larger investment programme more than absorbed that growth.

impacts.title: AI infrastructure spending absorbed cash
impacts.implication: Track lease and financing obligations alongside cash capex before drawing a conclusion on the funding burden.

events.headline: Both retail regions grew operating income
events.fact: North America operating income was $8.7B and International operating income was $1.6B, both higher year over year.

impacts.title: Both retail regions grew operating income
impacts.implication: Profit grew faster than sales. Track fulfilment and pricing through the holiday quarter.

impacts.title: Both retail regions grew operating income
impacts.implication: Regional profitability improved. Assess persistence across multiple quarters and currency conditions.

events.headline: Search revenue and traffic costs
events.fact: Search and other revenue rose from $56.57B to $63.35B. Total traffic acquisition costs rose from $14.88B to $16.37B.

impacts.title: Search revenue and traffic costs
impacts.implication: Search revenue grew while management reported stronger commercial query growth. AI-specific monetisation remains undisclosed here.

impacts.title: Search revenue and traffic costs
impacts.implication: TAC was roughly 20% of Google advertising revenue in both quarters. Monitor mix and remedy implementation.

events.headline: Cloud scale and reinvestment
events.fact: Cloud reported $30.7B of revenue and $11.1B of operating income. Alphabet recorded $127.1B of operating cash flow and $132.0B of property and equipment purchases for the first nine months.

impacts.title: Cloud scale and reinvestment
impacts.implication: Revenue more than doubled. Watch the conversion of contracted backlog into delivered and billed services.

impacts.title: Cloud scale and reinvestment
impacts.implication: Reported Cloud operating margin rose from about 23.7% to 36.2%. Check mix and shared costs when comparing returns.

impacts.title: Cloud scale and reinvestment
impacts.implication: Operating cash flow less property and equipment purchases was about −$4.8B for nine months versus +$48.7B a year earlier. This comparison is separate from the TTM cash-flow check.

events.headline: Search remedies remain in implementation
events.fact: The plaintiffs submitted their third status report on enforcement of the search final judgment.

impacts.title: Search remedies remain in implementation
impacts.implication: The court process remains material. Track actual changes to distribution terms and TAC before inferring an economic effect.

events.headline: Data Center and Compute & Networking expanded
events.fact: Data Center market-platform revenue increased 110% to $107.6B. Compute & Networking segment revenue rose 108% to $106.0B. GAAP gross margin was 74.8%.

impacts.title: Data Center and Compute & Networking expanded
impacts.implication: Revenue growth and initial Rubin shipments support the demand assessment.

impacts.title: Data Center and Compute & Networking expanded
impacts.implication: The reporting segment grew strongly. It overlaps the Data Center market platform, so the totals should not be added.

impacts.title: Data Center and Compute & Networking expanded
impacts.implication: Q3 gross margin was 1.4 points above last year. Q4 guidance of 71%–72% points to lower near-term margin.

events.headline: Inventory and customer exposure during the ramp
events.fact: Inventory rose to $39.7B from $31.6B. Receivables were $81.0B, with DSO rising from 60 to 64 days and the top two direct customers making up 35% of receivables.

impacts.title: Inventory and customer exposure during the ramp
impacts.implication: Inventory rose 26% sequentially against 20% revenue growth. Follow inventory conversion before inferring excess stock.

impacts.title: Inventory and customer exposure during the ramp
impacts.implication: Shipment timing and extended terms contributed to higher DSO. Monitor collection as sales scale.

impacts.title: Inventory and customer exposure during the ramp
impacts.implication: Three direct buyers accounted for 36% of revenue. Ultimate customer demand may be distributed differently.

events.headline: Funded backlog grew, while funding mix declined
events.fact: Total backlog increased year over year from $1.480B to $2.650B and funded backlog from $1.234B to $2.067B. Acquisitions added about $258M to the total increase. TTM book-to-bill was 1.6×.

impacts.title: Funded backlog grew, while funding mix declined
impacts.implication: Backlog grew about 79% with a disclosed acquisition contribution. Track organic awards and recognised revenue.

impacts.title: Funded backlog grew, while funding mix declined
impacts.implication: Funded dollars increased about 68%, but the funded share fell from about 83.4% to 78.0%.

impacts.title: Funded backlog grew, while funding mix declined
impacts.implication: At 1.6×, bookings exceeded billings over a full year. Conversion and profitability still need checking.

events.headline: Revenue growth has yet to translate into quarterly cash profit
events.fact: Kratos reported a $4.9M operating loss, $5.2M operating cash outflow and $30.2M capex. DSO was 125 days against 124 at year-end.

impacts.title: Revenue growth has yet to translate into quarterly cash profit
impacts.implication: Growth and improved adjusted EBITDA came alongside a GAAP operating loss. Separate segment execution from corporate costs.

impacts.title: Revenue growth has yet to translate into quarterly cash profit
impacts.implication: The issuer reported a $29.4M quarterly free cash outflow after its adjustment for asset sales and grants. The TTM check uses the dashboard’s own definition.

impacts.title: Revenue growth has yet to translate into quarterly cash profit
impacts.implication: DSO was broadly unchanged, but higher receivables and billing milestones absorbed cash as revenue scaled.

events.headline: Aurora-ID remains on its own approval pathway
events.fact: The Q3 filing describes site access, non-nuclear construction, and preliminary safety milestones at Aurora-ID.

impacts.title: Aurora-ID remains on its own approval pathway
impacts.implication: Site and early works approvals help advance the project. Watch construction progress and procurement.

impacts.title: Aurora-ID remains on its own approval pathway
impacts.implication: The preliminary safety milestones cover two of five DOE pathway steps described in the filing.

events.headline: Groves-1 clears a separate operating milestone
events.fact: Oklo announced DOE clearance for Groves-1 research and demonstration operations.

impacts.title: Groves-1 clears a separate operating milestone
impacts.implication: Groves-1 is a separate facility. A commercial Aurora operating date or authorization remains unverified.

events.headline: Meta fuel funding and corporate liquidity
events.fact: The Q3 filing reports an initial Meta-funded fuel payment. Corporate cash and marketable debt securities were $3.13B, with $110.9M of operating cash used over nine months.

impacts.title: Meta fuel funding and corporate liquidity
impacts.implication: A fuel-order credit advances the project. The disclosed 1.2 GW is a campus plan rather than verified fully financed capacity.

impacts.title: Meta fuel funding and corporate liquidity
impacts.implication: Liquidity supports near-term corporate operations. Capital spending and project financing requirements are separate from the operating cash-use figure.

catalysts.headline: October brokerage metrics
catalysts.fact: Interactive Brokers reported year-over-year account and margin loan growth alongside lower trading activity.
catalysts.assessment: Customer acquisition remains strong. Trading activity is lagging account growth.

next.label: November metrics in early December

catalysts.headline: Fed kept rates unchanged
catalysts.fact: The Fed held rates in October. The November 18 release of the minutes showed two voters preferred a quarter-point increase.
catalysts.assessment: The unchanged October rate supported near-term continuity. The next decision and client cash balances matter more for interest income than the October rate alone.

next.label: Fed decision

catalysts.headline: Q3 earnings rose as pretax margin edged lower
catalysts.fact: Diluted EPS rose to $0.69 from $0.59. Commissions rose 12% and net interest income rose 19%.
catalysts.assessment: Stronger earnings support the franchise thesis. Pretax margin slipped from 79% to 78%, and higher interest income partly reflected larger margin loans and credit balances.

next.label: Q4 results in January 2027

catalysts.headline: Q3 operating results
catalysts.fact: Net deposits were $15.7 billion, down from $20.4 billion in the year-earlier quarter.
catalysts.assessment: Funded-customer and Gold growth support franchise expansion, while net deposits slowed year over year.

next.label: Q4 operating results

catalysts.headline: Bookings outpaced billings, with uneven segment results
catalysts.fact: Q3 revenue rose 35.7% to $471.8M, while the company posted a $4.9M operating loss. Government Solutions operating income rose to $15.1M while Unmanned Systems moved to a $0.9M loss.
catalysts.assessment: Orders are expanding, but the quarterly operating loss and divergent segment results make conversion and margin the next tests.

next.label: Q4 deliveries, segment operating margins and funded conversion

catalysts.headline: AWS–Minfy collaboration extended to 2031
catalysts.fact: Minfy and AWS announced a five-year worldwide collaboration covering industry-specific AI solutions, with a target three times the previous agreement.
catalysts.assessment: The partnership provides a demand signal. Company-wide free cash flow was a $42.4B outflow over the last 12 months as infrastructure spending rose. Watch whether incremental cloud profit and cash generation catch up.

next.label: AWS capacity, capex and cloud profit update

catalysts.headline: Cloud benchmarks add context to a larger backlog
catalysts.fact: Google Cloud published TPU and GPU training benchmark results. Q3 filings show $560.8B of Google Cloud backlog, $30.7B of quarterly revenue and $11.1B of operating income.
catalysts.assessment: Cloud growth and operating profit are stronger evidence than benchmarks. Watch capacity delivery, related-party commitments and hardware mix as backlog converts.

next.label: Q4 revenue and margins, with an updated remaining-performance-obligations disclosure

catalysts.headline: Rubin shipments began as Data Center revenue grew
catalysts.fact: NVIDIA reported Vera Rubin NVL72 shipments, $107.6B in Data Center sales and 74.8% GAAP gross margin.
catalysts.assessment: Shipments provide stronger evidence of the ramp than capacity commitments alone. Compare reported margin with Q4 guidance of 71%–72%.

next.label: Q4 gross margin, shipments and inventory conversion

catalysts.headline: Definitive Centrus fuel contracts
catalysts.fact: Oklo signed multiyear HALEU supply agreements covering fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses; deliveries from the Ohio plant are scheduled to start in 2029.
catalysts.assessment: Binding fuel agreements reduce procurement uncertainty. Fabrication, delivery and site progress remain key milestones.

next.label: Fuel fabrication or construction milestone

catalysts.headline: October operating data follow the Q3 results
catalysts.fact: October funded customers reached 28.9M and net deposits were $15.1B, including roughly $6.5B of Trump Accounts contributions according to the November presentation.
catalysts.assessment: Customer growth continued. The deposit total includes a large contribution from one program, which limits its use as a recurring organic run rate.

next.label: November operating metrics, then Q4 Gold and ARPU

catalysts.headline: Card receivables and past-due balances rose
catalysts.fact: The 10-Q reports $1.841B of credit card receivables and $102M past due at September 30, compared with $1.040B and $49M at year-end 2025.
catalysts.assessment: Credit exposure grew and the past-due share rose from about 4.7% to 5.5%. Watch losses and provisioning as newer accounts age.

next.label: Q4 receivables, delinquencies and charge-offs

catalysts.headline: Prediction volumes grew while crypto volumes fell
catalysts.fact: October event contracts reached 5.9B, up 136% year over year, while crypto notional volume fell 48% year over year.
catalysts.assessment: The newer product is gaining activity. Reported volumes alone leave net contribution and regulatory exposure unresolved.

next.label: November product volumes and the next revenue breakdown

catalysts.headline: AWS growth accelerated in Q3
catalysts.fact: AWS reported about $46.0B of sales and $17.8B of operating income. Sales rose 39.3% year over year.
catalysts.assessment: Growth and segment profit support the cloud thesis. The next test is whether the capacity buildout sustains margin and improves returns on incremental capital.

next.label: Q4 AWS revenue, segment margin and remaining performance obligations

catalysts.headline: Retail operating income and ads expanded
catalysts.fact: North America operating income rose to $8.7B from $4.8B and International to $1.6B from $1.2B. Advertising revenue rose 11% as reported.
catalysts.assessment: Retail profitability improved across both regions. Compare holiday-period margins and normalise for the shift in Prime Day timing.

next.label: Q4 holiday retail margins and advertising revenue

catalysts.headline: Search revenue grew in Q3
catalysts.fact: Search and other revenue rose about 12% to $63.35B. Management reported stronger query growth, including commercial queries.
catalysts.assessment: Search revenue resilience supports the thesis. The disclosures do not quantify AI-specific revenue or unit serving costs.

next.label: Q4 Search revenue, query commentary and traffic acquisition costs

catalysts.headline: DOJ reports ongoing search-remedy implementation
catalysts.fact: The plaintiffs filed a third status report describing work under the final judgment, including Technical Committee setup and compliance implementation.
catalysts.assessment: The case remains relevant to distribution economics. The filing reports implementation activity rather than a measured impact on search traffic or revenue.

next.label: Next court filing or material remedy implementation update

catalysts.headline: Hyperscale sales expanded 71%
catalysts.fact: NVIDIA reported $60.1B in hyperscale revenue, up 71% year over year. Three direct customers represented 14%, 11% and 11% of total revenue.
catalysts.assessment: Hyperscale demand is substantial. Concentration is meaningful and direct customers can be intermediaries, so the filing does not establish end-customer exposures.

next.label: Hyperscaler earnings, AI capital spending and NVIDIA customer mix

catalysts.headline: Q4 outlook excludes China Data Center compute
catalysts.fact: NVIDIA disclosed $2.4B of Data Center Hopper product shipments to China in Q3 and assumed zero China Data Center compute revenue in its Q4 outlook.
catalysts.assessment: The Q4 assumption limits reliance on China compute sales for that forecast. Track export disclosures and supply commitments alongside actual revenue.

next.label: Next export-policy disclosure or Q4 shipment update

catalysts.headline: Gulf Space Technology awards gateway contract
catalysts.fact: Kratos announced a contract for THAICOM 10 ground infrastructure. The announcement did not give contract value.
catalysts.assessment: The award provides evidence of Space and Satellite demand. Follow the next backlog disclosure for its financial contribution.

next.label: New award values, funded backlog and conversion schedule

catalysts.headline: Growth consumed working capital and capex
catalysts.fact: Q3 operating cash outflow was $5.2M and capex was $30.2M. The 10-Q reports approximately $1.35B in net equity-issuance proceeds over the first nine months.
catalysts.assessment: Equity proceeds add liquidity alongside dilution. Watch collections and inventory as production scales.

next.label: Q4 operating cash flow, collections and capex

catalysts.headline: Groves-1 cleared for research operations
catalysts.fact: Oklo reported DOE clearance for unrestricted operations of its Groves-1 research and demonstration reactor. Its Q3 filing describes the separate Aurora-ID approval pathway.
catalysts.assessment: The milestone demonstrates progress on Groves-1. Aurora-ID has separate commercial approvals still to track.

next.label: Next documented Aurora-ID authorization or agency update

catalysts.headline: Meta fuel prepayment moved from escrow
catalysts.fact: The Q3 filing says initial Meta funding was paid directly to Centrus on November 2 as a credit toward fuel orders under the Ohio campus framework.
catalysts.assessment: Actual payment is stronger evidence than a framework announcement. The payment amount and fully funded, binding generating capacity remain unquantified in this disclosure.

next.label: Binding project terms, disclosed committed capacity or further funding milestones
